items.markdown:
To eat a durian, `find the star-shaped seam on the bottom, crack open the spiky husk, and scoop out the creamy, custard-like yellow flesh with a spoon or your fingers`.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rff2HTERlHM) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rff2HTERlHM)[[2]](https://www.finedininglovers.co.uk/explore/articles/what-is-durian)

Opening the Durian

- **Find the seam:** Look at the bottom of the fruit for a star-shaped pattern or natural lines.
- **Make a split:** Push your fingers or a knife tip into that bottom seam and pry the skin apart.
- **Pull apart:** Use your hands to pull the heavy sections of the husk open along the lines to reveal the pods inside.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rff2HTERlHM) [[1]](https://www.youtube.com/shorts/oCXA9XivjRs)[[2]](https://www.instagram.com/reel/DSIRqQVkp1S/)

Eating the Fruit

- **Remove the pods:** Scoop out the soft, creamy lobes using a spoon or clean fingers.
- **Watch out for seeds:** Each piece of flesh has a hard seed inside that you must not eat.
- **Taste it:** Bite the soft flesh off the seed. It should feel rich and smooth like sweet custard.[](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rff2HTERlHM) [[1]](https://www.thespruceeats.com/how-to-eat-durian-fruit-3217077)[[2]](https://cookingwithalison.com/2011/02/19/how-to-for-durian-fruit/)
